nodes.author: ThailandMedicaX
nodes.text: By inhibiting STAT2, HMPV effectively dampens the type I interferon response, skewing the immune system toward a Th2-type response. This Th2 dominance - marked by elevated levels of cytokines like IL-4 and IL-13 - is associated with allergic inflammation and asthma.

nodes.author: ThailandMedicaX
nodes.text: It is Hilarious that so many stupid doctors are making claims to the media that previous exposure to HMPV confers protection againt reinfections when in reality HMPV reinfections typically causes disease severity!
